name: Day List
job: Tell the reader what happens on each day of a short plan, one plain sentence per day, from Before to After.

anatomy.role: One or two words (Your week), headline size
An ordered list in one bordered box; rows split by a hairline
4.5rem column, bold, tabular, no wrap; a screen-reader `: ` follows it
One plain sentence, `text-wrap:pretty`; numbers keep a non-breaking hyphen (30‑minute)

states.name: Short plan
states.note: Before, Day 1, After: the list fits any length.

use_when: A short plan (a week or two) where the reader wants the shape of it before the detail.
Pair each row with the item ids it covers (`data-items`) so the consuming page can cross-check the list against the full grid.
avoid_when: Do not put more than one sentence on a day, or a status pill on a row; status lives in the status strip.
Do not use it for a plan over about ten days; use the full grid with the pinned details card instead.

data.note: `day` is the label (`Before`, `Day 1`, `After`); `text` is one sentence; `items` is an optional list of grid row ids for cross-checking.

access: A labelled `section` (`aria-labelledby` the heading) holding an `ol`, so screen readers announce the count and order.
The day is followed by a visually hidden `: `, so it reads Day 1: then the sentence rather than running together.
Rem sizing; the day column is 4.5rem and holds `Before` at the largest text size.

used_by.name: Approved My Ally Step 1 template (public/myally-hub.html, PR 2094)

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check` (in scripts): every page that marks this block carries it unchanged.
Reading-options check: 375 and 1280, light and dark, largest text size, roomy spacing and the easy-read font.
